title: Closure theorem in degree d + 1 < P from BR_P(d) and CL*_{P,d+1} by localization (parent V1–V2, Simon 6.8.3(1))
statement: Assume (MR), (IMC), (VO) (types of the accepted cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub, dtc_vanish_off_support). Let P, d ∈ ℕ with d + 1 < P and assume BR_P(d) (as in sibling boundary_im) and CL*_{P,d+1} (as in sibling closure_compact). Then CL_P(d+1): for every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and T_j, T ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U), if every T_j is IM, sup_j(M_W(T_j) + M_W(∂T_j)) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U and T_j ⇀ T, then T is IM.
